question: Through which Constitution Amendment Act was Article 39A inserted into the Constitution of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**42nd Amendment Act**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **42nd Amendment Act:**

 
 
• Article 39A was inserted into the **Constitution of India** through the **42nd Amendment Act, 1976**.
 
• This amendment is often referred to as the **"Mini-Constitution"** due to the extensive changes it brought to the Indian Constitution.
 
• Article 39A, part of the **Directive Principles of State Policy**, emphasizes providing **free legal aid** to ensure justice is accessible to all citizens.
 
• The 42nd Amendment also introduced other significant changes, including the addition of Fundamental Duties and the words "Socialist" and "Secular" to the Preamble.
 
• It was enacted during the **Emergency period** (1975-1977) under Prime Minister Indira Gandhi.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **48th Amendment Act:**

 
 
• The **48th Amendment Act, 1984** was enacted to extend the President's rule in Punjab for two years due to the prevailing insurgency.
 
• It amended **Article 356** of the Constitution, which deals with the imposition of President's rule in states.
 
• This amendment was specific to the situation in Punjab and did not introduce any new articles like Article 39A.
 
• It was a temporary measure to address the law and order situation in the state.
 
• The 48th Amendment is not related to the insertion of Article 39A.
 
 
 
• **46th Amendment Act:**
 
 
• The **46th Amendment Act, 1982** was enacted to bring certain transactions involving the transfer of goods under the scope of sales tax.
 
• It amended **Article 269** and **Article 286** to clarify the taxation of inter-state sales and consignments.
 
• This amendment aimed to resolve disputes related to sales tax and streamline tax collection.
 
• It did not introduce any new articles like Article 39A or focus on legal aid and justice.
 
• The 46th Amendment is unrelated to the Directive Principles of State Policy.
 
 
 
• **44th Amendment Act:**
 
 
• The **44th Amendment Act, 1978** was enacted to reverse some of the changes made by the 42nd Amendment and restore the balance of power.
 
• It strengthened fundamental rights, limited the duration of the Emergency, and ensured judicial independence.
 
• This amendment was a response to the excesses of the Emergency period and aimed to protect democratic principles.
 
• It did not introduce Article 39A, as this had already been done by the 42nd Amendment.
 
• The 44th Amendment focused on safeguarding citizens' rights and democratic institutions.
